name: Puzzle
summary: AI accounting software for startups that categorizes transactions, drafts statements and can also be paired with bookkeeping services.
description: AI accounting software for startups that categorizes transactions, drafts statements and can also be paired with bookkeeping services.

pricing.details: Software-only, “you close the books”. A Monthly / Yearly toggle is present (“12 months for the price of 10”). Starter 27 €/month — 25 lifetime AI credits, 1 seat; Core 65 €/month — 25 lifetime AI credits, 5 seats, plus insights, spend and revenue tracking, variance analysis, advanced reporting; Complete 109 €/month — 100 AI credits/month, unlimited seats, AI accuracy review, AI reconciliations and insights, classes/departments/projects, revenue recognition, priority support; Scale 326 €/month — 300 AI credits/month, unlimited seats, higher-volume accounting, subledgers, no transaction or integration limits, backup and restore, dedicated onboarding. Each paid software plan has a “Try for free” path
pricing.label: Premium

features: Automatic categorization of most transactions and auto-drafted cash and accrual statements
Unlimited connections; AI Suite (Chat, Cowork, Close) with plan-based AI credits
Insights on cash, burn, runway and margin from Core up
Monthly software plans; yearly billing uses a “12 months for the price of 10” offer on the official site.
